bio: L'Homard Bizarre translates as the bizarre lobster, but there is nothing at all outlandish about this elegant, cosily decorated villa. The chef does, however, have a predilection for lobster! As he is a champion of classic cuisine, his menu features timeless dishes such as fried foie gras with diced apple, or ultra-fresh lobster Bellevue with house-made sauces and a crisp salad. As ever, seafood lovers and meat enthusiasts are treated to a host of full flavours....
